title: Acute Stroke Classification Using Asymmetric Data Standardization and Orthogonal-Focal Loss Optimized CNN-ViT Cross-Attention Fusion: A Multicenter External Validation Study
abstract: arXiv:2610.34529v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Background/Objectives: Rapid differentiation of ischemic and hemorrhagic stroke subtypes is vital for acute management. Although current deep learning models achieve high single-dataset accuracy, they suffer from "shortcut learning" and domain shift in external validation. This study proposes a hierarchical computer-aided diagnostic (CAD) system mimicking emergency triage. Methods: We introduce a 3-channel Radiology-Focused Preprocessing pipeline that feeds radiological Hounsfield Unit (HU) windows into Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and Vision Transformer (ViT) backbones via asymmetric formats (.mat and .png). The architecture utilizes a novel joint cross-attention fusion network optimized by an Integrated Orthogonal-Focal Loss. Results: Our system achieved a 95.48% F1-score on the internal stroke dataset. However, multi-center external validation (AISD, BHSD, PhysioNet) using a Mask Anchor filter revealed a drop to the 58-62% ran

translated_title: 基于非对称数据标准化与正交-焦点损失优化的CNN-ViT交叉注意力融合的急性脑卒中分类：一项多中心外部验证研究
translated_abstract: 背景/目标：快速鉴别缺血性与出血性脑卒中亚型对急性期管理至关重要。尽管当前的深度学习模型在单一数据集上取得了很高的准确率，但在外部验证中存在“捷径学习”和域偏移问题。本研究提出了一种模拟急诊分诊的分层计算机辅助诊断（CAD）系统。方法：我们引入了一个三通道的放射学聚焦预处理流水线，通过非对称格式（.mat 和 .png）将放射学Hounsfield单位（HU）窗口输入到卷积神经网络（CNN）和视觉Transformer（ViT）骨干网络中。该架构采用了一种由集成正交-焦点损失优化的新型联合交叉注意力融合网络。结果：我们的系统在内部脑卒中数据集上达到了95.48%的F1分数。然而，使用掩码锚点过滤器的多中心外部验证（AISD、BHSD、PhysioNet）显示性能下降至58-62%区间。
tldr: 该研究提出一种模拟急诊分诊的分层CAD系统，通过非对称数据标准化和正交-焦点损失优化的CNN-ViT交叉注意力融合实现急性脑卒中分类，内部验证F1分数达95.48%，但多中心外部验证揭示了性能降至58-62%的域偏移问题。
en_tdlr: This study proposes a hierarchical CAD system mimicking emergency triage for acute stroke classification using asymmetric data standardization and an Orthogonal-Focal Loss optimized CNN-ViT cross-attention fusion, achieving a 95.48% F1-score internally while multicenter external validation revealed domain shift with performance dropping to the 58-62% range.
